gaps: No Avalonia test harness exists yet.
Route equivalence is not machine-enforced yet.
The graph surface tracked by #798 has no standalone route in app.routes.ts; current roadmap places its owning daily-work work after the November core preview unless #798 is amended.
Some deep-link/admin/report surfaces do not have an obviously named dedicated top-level Playwright spec; later issues must cite exact cases rather than infer coverage.
Browser file primitives require native desktop upload/download/preview/cancel/error-path tests.
Realtime authorization, protected-state clearing and stale-epoch behavior require dedicated desktop coverage.
Declared-but-unused NgRx dependencies can mislead migration planning and should be rechecked before dependency cleanup.
